name: fmwax-house
description: fmwax: a house of radio DJs on the presets of a WiiM. This file is for the Deploy to Cloudflare button; the house itself is in mcp/.

SETUP_KEY.description: **Make up a password of 24 characters or more. Write it in a note first, then paste it here**: this box hides what you type, and you paste it once more on your house's setup page to claim the house. Letters and numbers are enough.
